description.value: Mashti Cafe describes itself as the first Iranian juice and ice cream bar in British Columbia, serving fresh juices, smoothies, shakes, ice creams, and traditional Persian sweets at its flagship North Vancouver location on Lonsdale Avenue. Founded by Armin NejadYousefi and Hooman Khabbaz, the business brings Persian hospitality to the community with both indoor and outdoor seating available. It operates multiple locations including a Coquitlam branch and a wholesale operation, suggesting an established and growing presence.
